messages.author: fe756cf51e487a56
messages.subject: RSQLite crashing apache?
parts:
Hi, I've got some code running in RApache (Apache 2.2.3-31, Centos,
R-2.10). However on loading the GOstats package I see a stack trace in
my error logs:

Loading required package: DBI
*** glibc detected *** /usr/sbin/httpd: free(): invalid pointer:
0x00002b43af5eba28 ***
======= Backtrace: =========
/lib64/libc.so.6[0x2b43a32152ef]
/lib64/libc.so.6(cfree+0x4b)[0x2b43a321573b]
/usr/lib64/R/library/RSQLite/libs/RSQLite.so(sqlite3_initialize+0x243)
[0x2b43b0a8ffc3]
/usr/lib64/R/library/RSQLite/libs/RSQLite.so[0x2b43b0a9a6eb]
/usr/lib64/R/library/RSQLite/libs/RSQLite.so(RS_SQLite_newConnection
+0x12f)[0x2b43b0a7aaef]
/usr/lib64/R/lib/libR.so[0x2b43aa3f45e7]

....

The problem looks like it stems from RSQLite, but when I load RSQLite
by itself it works fine. If I try out RSQLite examples at the R
command line, it works fine. My system has sqlite 3.3.6-5 installed
and RSQLite 0.8.3.

Has anybody seen this behavior before?

Thanks,
Rajarshi

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Re: RSQLite crashing apache?
parts:
Hi Rajarshi,

Sorry it took so long to respond...

Looks like there may be issues with your setup. Maybe your OS needs an
update, maybe just the libc libraries. I don't know. I tested the
following rapache handler on Ubuntu jaunty (9.04) 64bit, R 2.10.0,
rapache 1.1.8, and RSQLite 0.8-4 and it works like a champ:

library(RSQLite)
library(datasets)
handler <- function(){
setContentType('text/plain')
conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(),dbname='/tmp/
sqlite_test',flags=SQLITE_RWC)
dbWriteTable(conn,'iris',iris)
print(dbReadTable(conn,'iris'))
dbDisconnect(conn)
}

Best,

Jeff
